rows.layout: lane i -> [Vectors[i].a, Vectors[i].b, Vectors[i].c, 0] (struct words 0,1,2; Input[lane*4+3] stays 0)

notes: Prologue sentinels 0xabcdabcd in v10..v14 and v18 go in pre: the 16-bit ops keep the high half (Expected has 0xabcd in the high half).

Result columns 0..10 are stored from v10..v20 (identity). Column 10 (v20 = v_mov v20,v6 then VOP2 opcode 0x06 at word 36) is EXCLUDED: that encoding is v_mac_legacy_f32 (unfused) on gfx1013 but v_fmac_legacy_f32 (fused) on gfx103x, so the gfx1036 oracle executes a different instruction. Words 35-36 still run (they only write v20).
The test runs the 256 vectors 32 per dispatch; the ALU is lane-independent, so all 256 rows can go in one oracle run.
Check(): columns 0,1 accept any f16 NaN with equal high half; columns 9,10 accept any f32 NaN and are skipped when a, b or expected[9] is an f32 denormal.
verified: disassembly: llvm-mc gfx1030 (gfx1013 cross-check for opcode aliasing) of the word range; Run()/Check() read for register use, row layout and asserted columns; gfx1013/gfx1030 decode differs only at word 36 (mac_legacy vs fmac_legacy)
